args.title: Corvid Packaging Newsletter Summary - Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
• Newsletter headline: Freight pricing this quarter - spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Linked article (blog.corvid.example/2026/freight): Confirms the spot vs. contract rate divergence and the shift to weekly diesel-indexed fuel surcharges as the key market dynamic this quarter.
• Companion piece (insights.corvid.example/freight/companion): Shippers who split their volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs, suggesting multi-carrier diversification as a cost-mitigation strategy.
